# Commander

Commander is a local-first multi-agent orchestration tool for engineering work.

## Public documentation

- Quick start: https://pstarh.github.io/commander-docs/getting-started.html
- Deployment: https://pstarh.github.io/commander-docs/deployment.html
- Operations and rollback: https://pstarh.github.io/commander-docs/operations.html
- Security and privacy: https://pstarh.github.io/commander-docs/security.html
- SDKs and API: https://pstarh.github.io/commander-docs/sdk.html
- Benchmarks: https://pstarh.github.io/commander-docs/benchmarks.html
- Support and limits: https://pstarh.github.io/commander-docs/support.html
- Enterprise Shadow Phase A: https://github.com/PStarH/Commander/blob/codex/release-20260810/docs/pilot/shadow/README.md

## Product boundary

- Current enterprise evaluation uses historical observations; it does not execute or authorize external actions. Live Kubernetes rollback is frozen.

- Local API: http://localhost:4000
- Local web interface: http://localhost:3000
- Enterprise Gateway is alpha, not production-proven multi-tenant SaaS.
- Benchmarks are CI or harness evidence, not production SLA or certification.
